purpose: Research request "Population and groups" (area C of the P2 game-substrate plan). Community templates (entries and crowd pools), the world community registry, light-crowd entity templates and the quest phases that switch communities, serialised to JSON, for analysing who is spawned where; read together with the TweakDB character, affiliation and district records. Derived from game files: private, ignored by git, never packaged.

tool.name: WolvenKit CLI
tool.whyThisVersion: The same tool, version and settings as areas A and B (quest-corpus-a-manifest.json).

archives.archive/pc/content/basegame_4_gamedata.a: base-game open-world communities, phases and quests
archives.archive/pc/content/basegame_4_appearance: light-crowd entity templates and appearance files, the characters CSV
the always-loaded sector that holds the world community registry

commands: WolvenKit.CLI archive PATH_TO_GAME/archive/pc/content/basegame_4_gamedata.archive -l   (and the same for basegame_3_nightcity, basegame_4_appearance and ep1_2_gamedata: path listing only, to choose what to extract)
WolvenKit.CLI convert serialize SCRATCH/raw   (default settings; one .json written beside each resource, then collected into json/ with the same relative paths)
WolvenKit.CLI convert serialize SCRATCH/world/<each sector>   (only always_loaded_1, which holds the single worldCommunityRegistryNode, is kept)
run: Every WolvenKit call ran under tools/memory_guard.py with a limit of 4 GB (6 GB for the sector conversions; peak 2.5 GB). The game was not running.

included: base/open_world/community (every district community template, phase and quest), city_scenes, dynamic_events, vendors, mini_world_stories and police_system community templates, district_definitions, community_spawners (debug spawner entities)
base/characters/entities/light_crowd and appearances/light_crowd, base/characters/communities.csv, base/gameplay/community/community_spawnsets.csv and the Phantom Liberty counterpart
excluded: quest-owned communities outside open_world (side quests, minor quests, main quests: about 4,000 base and 1,400 Phantom Liberty files)
streamable sectors (community area nodes, population spawner nodes, traffic)
scenes, journal files, localisation (read separately, not kept)

examinedNotKept.what: TweakDB, base game (read with the Studio flat reader plus the record section and the name list)
WolvenKit TweakDB name list (source checkout 11720772), decompressed with the game's Oodle library: 196,216 record names, 3,333,134 flat names, 490 query names
English on-screen texts, for display names
Always-loaded sectors 0 and 2 (community area nodes only, counted)
Three NPC entity templates (citizen__homeless_man, citizen__corporat_wa, gang__maelstrom_ma), for voice components and look pools

note: Area C (population and groups) files, added on top of areas A and B. Tracked copy: research/story-engine/quest-corpus-c-manifest.json. Derived analysis outputs and the analysis scripts are in _derived-c.
